== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Portable Fusion Generator (Japanese)|Portable Fusion Generator]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/159563443/MsdLxWEar0W6pJqkZBuvvg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 92654371.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9cdf9fd42a9421b5315cab5cebee013093e68d4c07212fb50d42f356e09eb6e4</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
